what: GPU painterly passes (web/shaders/paint/gpu.mjs) against the CPU reference (web/shaders/paint/paint.mjs)
frame: web/shaders/fixtures/street.mjs streetScene(240, 150, 0), dusk; and daylight for the watercolour daylight case
compare: 8-bit sRGB from encodePaint8 / PAINT_ENCODE_WGSL, per channel, all pixels
why_looser_than_the_other_shaders: The stroke pass follows the flow field for up to 16 steps, rounding to the nearest pixel at each; an f32 rounding on a half-pixel or a sign check on a near-perpendicular step can send one stroke down a different path, which moves that stroke's relief and colour jitter by a few codes. The bound allows isolated strokes of that kind, not a systematic difference.
